project_dependencies.use: Frozen grammar and Vasu at the end of 5.1.
PG36 selectors and its source policies.
PG770 owns nominative audgātram under the udgātṛ class.
Native graded coefficient and history carrier.

source_observations.observation: Final ik and its local syllabic environment are independent tests. Kavi is assigned to another lexical route.
The base has at least three syllables, y as upadhā and a heavy penultimate syllable. Cites the special sahāya option.
Coordinated words and the manojña class. The grammatical examples distinguish feminine and neuter outputs.
Explicit instrumental and accusative examples from a lineage and school, and instrumental glosses with tva.
Reports disagreement on sāhāyyam and gives further dvandva and attainment examples.
Plural class of named officiants. Frozen examples include mitrāvaruṇīyam and tvaṣṭrīyam.
The transmitted field has long initial vowels in two examples and meṣṭrīyam. Maintain the file reading alongside the differing Kāśikā list.
Brahman in its ritual office is the special tva case. Class-denoting brahman can take tva or tal.
The two lists place purity and silence respectively in accounts of bodily and mental austerity.
The sūtra begins with a causal ablative while the bhāṣya has the same stem as object of the act of undertaking.
Two overt feminine datives and an accusative agree in reference with particular hotrā offices. The first oblique in sentence 2 has a different ending.
The adjacent tva status predication and feminine office agreeing with hotrā are overtly distinct.
Four distinct functional words are objects of performing. The same section distinguishes a brāhmaṇa's class status as the object of knowing.
The listed udgātṛ and adhvaryu take añ in this usage. Hotṛ occurs in the separate yuvādi list at 130.
